steps.en: Run the one-line installer, which prints the memory prompt block
steps.zh: 运行一行安装脚本，它会打印出记忆提示块

steps.en: Drops one dependency-free Python file at ~/.optmem/memo and creates the store
steps.zh: 把零依赖的单文件工具放到 ~/.optmem/memo，建好存储

steps.en: Paste the printed block at the top of your agent's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
steps.zh: 把打印出的块粘贴到 agent 的 AGENTS.md／CLAUDE.md 顶部

steps.en: Every session, your agent reads its memory before anything else
steps.zh: 每个会话，agent 先读记忆再做任何事

steps.en: Your agent records one line whenever it learns something worth keeping
steps.zh: agent 每学到值得留下的事，就记一行

steps.en: Appends fixed-width records to the log; when a merge is due, asks for it
steps.zh: 把定长记录追加进日志；合并到期时提出来

steps.en: The next wake prints the rebuilt summary tree plus newest memories, in budget
steps.zh: 下一次 wake 在预算内打印重建的摘要树和最新记忆

value.en: Every future session — any model, any harness — starts knowing what was decided and tried
value.zh: 以后每个会话——无论换什么模型、什么 harness——都知道之前定过什么、试过什么

sources: https://github.com/VictorTaelin/OptMem README Install (curl | sh line; prints a ## Memory block to paste at the top of AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md; tool lands at ~/.optmem/memo)
README Commands (memo wake / note / nap / recall / zoom / forget; merges arrive one at a time in the output of note)
README The prompt (wake before any other tool call every session; note on anything worth keeping; nap answers pending compressions)
README Files (~/.optmem/memory: LOG.txt append-only, TREE/ rebuildable summaries, config)
